name: sports-coaching
description: Coaches teach a sport one on one or in small groups, paid per session, in person or online.

description.description: The coaching offered, or the coaching looked for.

price.description: The price of one session, per person.

payment.description: How a session may be paid: direct, session, or both.

sport.description: The sport, such as tennis or swimming.

levels.description: The levels coached: beginner, intermediate, advanced, competitive.

groupSize.description: The most people in one session: 1 for one on one.

minutes.description: How long one session lasts, in minutes.

place.description: Where sessions are held, or online. A coach who does both writes two posts.

howDealsGo: The coach and the student, or a parent for a child, agree in messages on the sport, the times and the place, and pay outside Forest. After a session each may review the other. A review of the person who wrote the post names it.
